subject: CAIQ reconciler index and evidence ownership handoff
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@archonhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@archonhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ request: reconciler index + evidence owner roster

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on. Were starting an internal CSA/CAIQ review tied to our procurement window and need a compact "reconciler index" from Redwood that: 1) maps each CAIQ control to a single canonical Redwood artifact (policy, log sample, diagram), 2) lists the internal owner for that artifact, and 3) surfaces any controls where the evidence is still TODO.

Key asks:
- Deliver an index (spreadsheet or CSV) with control id, artifact link, artifact type, owner (name + email), and evidence status.
- Provide a short onboarding guide for our security reviewers to access the evidence portal (guest links / SSO expectations).
- Call out any controls that require a scoped exception or additional attestation.

Can you confirm scope (tenant-level runtime + control plane) and an estimated turnaround? We're targeting an internal review kickoff on Aug 23.

Appreciate it,

Alice Park
Head of Security Programs
Archon Health
alice.park@archonhealth.com
[Attachment: CAIQ snapshot (requested scope).pdf]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@archonhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: reconciler index + evidence owner roster

Alice — thanks for the clear asks. Confirming scope: tenant-level runtime + control plane (we will exclude customer-managed on-prem artifacts unless you explicitly request scope expansion).

Deliverables I propose:
- CAIQ Reconciler Index (spreadsheet) mapping each CAIQ control to a single canonical artifact and owner.
- Evidence portal package: per-control access links (timeboxed guest tokens) and a short onboarding guide.
- Exception log: controls needing additional attestation or customer-facing notes.

Tentative timeline: 10 business days for a first pass index (Aug 18), follow-up 3 business days for portal access provisioning and evidence handover. If you need the kickoff on Aug 23 we can accelerate with an initial index + partial portal access by Aug 16.

I've attached a lightweight reconciler template to illustrate the expected columns and will populate it during the intake sprint. Kimberly will provision portal accounts and run the guest-access checklist; Marissa will help triage any controls requiring legal/PO engagement.

Action items for Archon: please confirm if you want on-prem artifacts in scope and provide a short list of any high-priority control ids (if any). Also confirm the reviewing personas (security reviewers vs. compliance).

Thanks — sending template now.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: caiq-reconciler-template.xlsx]
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: reconciler index + evidence owner roster

Hi Alice / Rishi — quick operational notes from the Console/evidence portal side: 

1) Guest provisioning: we can grant timeboxed, read-only guest links for specific artifacts (log samples, diagrams). To minimize exposure we will create per-reviewer links scoped to the control ids you designate.
2) Artifact mapping: our portal expects a single canonical artifact link per control id to keep the reconciler deterministic. We'll map additional artifacts as "supporting" rows.
3) Redaction & retention: any log snippets will be redacted for PII by default; if you need original snippets we require a signed NDA addendum.

I'll start provisioning access once we have the list of reviewer emails and confirm which controls are high-priority. Attached is the portal onboarding checklist and required fields for each artifact in the reconciler spreadsheet.

Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: portal-onboarding-checklist.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@archonhealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ request: reconciler index + evidence owner roster

Thanks all — quick confirmation and proposed cadence.

- We'll deliver the first-pass reconciler index by EOD Aug 16 with owners populated and "evidence status" (Complete / In progress / Needs attestation).
- Portal guest links for the high-priority control subset will go live on Aug 18; Kimberly will send invite tokens and the checklist.
- I'll owner the exceptions log and coordinate any DocuSign attestation requests with legal. If Archon needs any control-specific language for procurement, send a prioritized list and we'll draft the attestation excerpt.

Next steps for Archon: reply with 1) confirmation of scope (confirm no on-prem), 2) list of reviewer emails for guest access, 3) priority control ids (if any).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
